name: Daily entry/exit study: six fixed rules, eight markets, two leverage levels
execution: Signals on completed daily bars; market orders at next available open; pre-existing trailing stop fills at worse of stop or opening bid on gaps. Current-bar highs only update tomorrow's trailing stop. No same-bar optimistic stop raising.
positioning: One long position per candidate. Leveraged positions rebalance to 1.5x at each session open, paying turnover costs. Borrowing is actual negative cash, charged for calendar days; unused positive cash earns zero. Full-notional CFD funding is NOT this margin-account model.
pass_rule: CAGR >15% and drawdown <=40% in full and post-2020 samples at ALL cost scenarios; all monthly/3m/6m native sign tests and N=1 PSR pass in full and chronological test samples; Holm correction across 192 hypotheses (profit and excess versus matched buy-and-hold, all 96 candidates); native PBO <=50% separately per market using six windows. Benchmark outperformance is a separate flag.
selection: Choose one market/rule/leverage by highest mean monthly return in 2019-2020 at base costs, with no drawdown qualification using later data; report 2021-2025 frozen selection. Retrospective analysis, not untouched OOS.
limitations: Seven evaluation years are a short sample for a 15% long-run target.
Dukascopy quotes are not IG execution quotes; bid/ask OHLC extremes need not occur simultaneously.
ETF prices require independently checked corporate-action adjustment; failed data checks exclude an instrument before strategy performance is inspected, with reasons recorded.
USD performance is not directly comparable with the preceding EUR allocation study.
Cash/spot plus financed margin is modeled, not IG cash CFDs, perpetual funding, leveraged ETFs or guaranteed stops.
Fixed annual financing assumptions of 8% and 12% are sensitivity scenarios, not reconstructed broker quotations.
Earlier research and publication-selection bias remain unknown; all new trials are recorded.
